source: actual edited UI request and fitted design; all geometry millimetres

fit.method: 10 deterministic starts; SciPy max_nfev=500 per start, with additional numerical Jacobian calls. One finite found candidate, no uniqueness or arbitrary-path guarantee.

baseline.scope: Nominal samples only; no clearance proof

report.method: Outward interval circle closure and clamped closest-point capsule projection; conservative degenerate segment hull. Entire angular cover, independent dimensional intervals; nominal interior collision witnesses only.
limits: One uniformly timed revolution, one fixed-topology positive assembly branch.
Nominal collisions; clear covers every declared independent dimension/radius interval.
Ground/r/p/q/u/v and nonnegative body radii vary; phase/yaw/translation are exact.
Only fixed circular obstacles versus declared capsules/tool disk; no own-link collisions.
No loads, flex, joint play, manufacturing/process or physical-safety guarantee.
Outward mpmath interval basic operations at 30 decimal digits; interval support is experimental.
report.reason: A nominal interval is strictly inside the expanded obstacle; not a tolerance-only overlap
